```{python}
#| label: imports
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from plotnine import *
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
```


```{python}
#| label: load-data
df = pd.read_csv('./data/variants.csv')

# Ensure ordered factors for consistent axis / facet ordering
df['read_length'] = pd.Categorical(df['read_length'], categories=[30, 40, 50, 60, 70], ordered=True)
df['aligner']     = pd.Categorical(df['aligner'],     categories=['bwa_aln', 'grave_15_5'], ordered=True)
df['type']        = pd.Categorical(df['type'],         categories=['SNPs', 'MNPs', 'Indels', 'Other'], ordered=True)

ALIGNER_LABELS = {'bwa_aln': 'BWA aln', 'grave_15_5': 'grave (15, 5)'}
ALIGNER_COLOURS = {'bwa_aln': '#0072B2', 'grave_15_5': '#D55E00'}

df['aligner_label'] = df['aligner'].map(ALIGNER_LABELS)
df['aligner_label'] = pd.Categorical(
    df['aligner_label'],
    categories=[ALIGNER_LABELS[a] for a in ['bwa_aln', 'grave_15_5']],
    ordered=True
)
```

```{python}
#| label: plot
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7

p = (
    ggplot(df, aes(x='factor(read_length)', y='count', fill='aligner_label'))
    + geom_col(position=position_dodge(width=0.75), width=0.7)
    + facet_wrap('~ type', scales='free_y', ncol=2)
    + scale_fill_manual(
        values={
            ALIGNER_LABELS['bwa_aln']:    '#3A7DBF',
            ALIGNER_LABELS['grave_15_5']: '#E8874A',
        },
        name='Aligner'
    )
    + scale_y_continuous(labels=lambda lst: [f'{v/1000:.0f}k' if v >= 1000 else f'{int(v)}' for v in lst])
    + labs(
        x='Read length (bp)',
        y='Variant count',
        title='Variant counts by type, aligner and read length',
    )
    + theme_bw(base_size=12)
    + theme(
        figure_size=(10, 7),
        panel_grid_major_x=element_blank(),
        panel_grid_minor=element_blank(),
        strip_background=element_rect(fill='#f0f0f0', colour='#cccccc'),
        strip_text=element_text(size=11, face='bold'),
        legend_position='bottom',
        legend_title=element_text(size=10),
        legend_text=element_text(size=10),
        plot_title=element_text(size=13, face='bold'),
        axis_title=element_text(size=11),
    )
)

p.save('variant_counts.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
p
```
